source_admission_states.scope: Source ownership is reconstructed from dispatch and first client output. These are sampled host admission states, not P GPU busy/idle intervals. Credit-full blocking can reflect downstream D service. It is not proof of P compute saturation.

results.scope: Coordinator queues sampled approximately every50ms. D_pipeline_waiting contains completed P work awaiting D admission. It is not the D worker decode-ready queue, a transfer duration or a physical GPU-idle measurement. Arrival-window growth is descriptive. A finite cohort does not establish stable long-run capacity.
